mainEntity.name: Is Tony Brooks a certified fly casting instructor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tony Brooks is a Certified Casting Instructor through Fly Fishers International (FFI), a credential reflecting both his technical mastery of fly casting and his dedication to teaching.

mainEntity.name: How long has Tony Brooks been guiding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tony has been guiding professionally since 2009 and has been fly fishing for over 50 years.

mainEntity.name: What rivers and streams does Tony Brooks guide and specialize in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tony specializes in Western North Carolina mountain streams, including the Davidson River and Pisgah National Forest, and Big Santeetlah Creek, with a focus on dry fly and nymph technique for beginner and intermediate anglers.

mainEntity.name: Has Tony Brooks competed in national fly fishing competitions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Tony competed in the 2016 U.S. National Fly Fishing Championship in Lake Placid, NY, and served as a sector judge at the 2024 championship in Cherokee, NC. He is also a member of the competitive fly fishing team, Team Stonefly.

mainEntity.name: What organizations is Tony Brooks affiliated with?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tony is President and a member of the French Broad Fly Fishers and a member of Team Stonefly, a competitive fly fishing team.
